extras: Desktop only. Data is stored locally in .obsidian/plugins/vault-time-tracker/data.json.
motivation: The author built it because standard time trackers pause when the application loses focus, which does not reflect how note-taking work actually happens.
problem: Standard time trackers pause when the application loses focus, failing to account for real-world workflows where users switch applications while actively working on a note.
summary: Tracks time spent on notes, keeping the timer running even when Obsidian is minimized or when switching to other applications.
